o: His younger brother Miloš, in a violent storm
questions.e: In a storm he lost his younger brother Miloš.

questions.q: Why did Radovan set off into the mountains?
o: To ask Morana to take away a painful memory
To look for his missing brother
questions.e: “I'll find Morana to take this memory from me.”

questions.q: What did his neighbour Uncle Milutin warn him?
o: That it would cost a lot
That Morana was an evil witch
That forgetting is a sharp sword: cutting a painful branch may cut the root too

questions.q: What did Morana weave on her loom?
questions.e: She wove human dreams and forgotten memories.

questions.q: What did Morana explain about pain and love?
o: That the pain would pass on its own
They are woven into one thread: forgetting the pain means forgetting his brother
That the pain can be forgotten and love kept
questions.e: “My loom cannot separate pain from love.”

o: To keep the memory: pain is the price of love
questions.e: “I'll carry my pain, because it is the price of the love I had.”

questions.q: What changed in Radovan's life after he came back?
o: He opened the windows, replanted his fields and told neighbours stories about Miloš
questions.e: Fields replanted, neighbours listening to stories about Miloš.
